game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Herbalist Hut Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut, a herbalist's hut: the beast tamer must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut: a herbalist's hut
core_gameplay_loop: In Herbalist Hut, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round, giant beetles strike the root gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the root gate from giant beetles in Herbalist Hut: keep the roll_call meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: roll_call drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
